_comment: SIH26038 Phase 4B — optic-disc localization baseline. ENGINEERING HEURISTICS tuned on 5 Drishti-GS training images only (frozen thereafter). All area thresholds are FOV-normalized fractions (resolution independent). Weights sum to 1.0.

working_resolution.comment: Internal processing width; coordinates mapped back to original. Documented, not hidden.

candidates.comment: Red-channel top-percentile bright regions in FOV, filtered by normalized area + shape.

convergence.comment: Vessel density in annulus [r, 2r] around candidate vs global FOV density (Phase 4A mask at working resolution). Support evidence only.

scoring.comment: Weighted sum of 0..1 features; contributions exposed per candidate.
